author: Zensubmarine
quote:
I’ve been playing GTA franchise for 2 decades. 

When Dan Houser left the franchise died. Blackrock and all the corporate money came in and then so did wokeness and political correctness. 
It’s now a glorified Sims game. Not a GTA game. 

Now you can’t unalive protesters. Or people in nightclubs of certain sexual orientation. This creates protected classes which means others are unprotected. Not saying I want to either but it’s the principle. 

What made GTA special was its open world sandbox experience with extreme violence and dark twisted humour. 

The storyline is just awful. I wish any former previous characters could see what happened to their world. CJ, Trevor, Michael or Tommy would verbally insult the new protagonists to the hilt and probably physically assault them. 

I seen the photos of the new staff at rockstar. 

Let’s just say by their appearance I am unsurprised that the new game is a dumpster fire.
